newsitem.title: YEMEN: Saudi interior minister in Yemen for talks.
newsitem.headline: Saudi interior minister in Yemen for talks.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister Prince Nayef arrived in Yemen on Monday on a one-day official visit during which he is expected to meet President Ali Abdullah Saleh, a Yemeni official said.
Prince Nayef was expected to convey a message from King Fahd to the president when they meet later on Monday, the official told Reuters. He gave no details.
The visit is mainly aimed at following up on talks held in August between Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan and Yemeni officials, including discussions on their mutual borders.

Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a potentially oil- and gas-rich border area before the two sides signed last year a memorandum of understanding to resolve the 60-year-old border dispute.
Prince Sultan's landmark visit appeared to put an end to years of tension and mistrust between the neighbours.

In July, Prince Nayef and his Yemeni counterpart Hussein Mohammad Arab signed a security pact and an agreement to fight drug trafficking. The security pact is part of last year's memorandum of understanding.

Four Saudis, who confessed in April to bombing a U.S.-run military training centre in Riyadh last year killing five Americans and two Indians, said they had smuggled the explosives from Yemen. The four were beheaded in May.
